protocol.round rules: Even parity, ordinary fresh count, loose distinctions free, every shortest change through each distinction.
protocol.sampling: Labelled connected starts with replacement. Accept only if every listed support has at least three distinctions and the start is within its cohort cap.
protocol.historical sample: Meeting probability 1/3 independently per pair, one or two shared distinctions and zero, one or two loose distinctions chosen uniformly, cap 18. Seed 20261206 plus number of knots.
protocol.larger sample: Meeting probability 2.75/(n-1) independently per pair, one or two shared distinctions and zero, one or two loose distinctions chosen uniformly, cap 3*n. Seed 61261226 plus number of knots.
protocol.larger funded sample: Meeting probability 2.25/(n-1) independently per pair, double with probability 1/4. Each knot gets the maximum of its round-one demand with all knots live, one, and the count needed for three distinctions. Add one loose distinction independently with probability 1/3. Cap 8*n. Seed 81261226 plus number of knots.
protocol.testable stage: At least four classes (label rank at least two).
protocol.candidate: Label rank minus rank of the span of readings on individual listed supports is at least two.
protocol.K1\u2013K3 readers: Restrict that span to supports with at least three distinctions whose allowed-state projection passes K1–K3.
protocol.limits: Larger sizes and longer runs outside the displayed frame were not tested. Stages beyond the distinction cap were not read.
